reverse_candidate_rows.quote_en: The platform ingests enterprise documents and user-submitted cases, searches permitted knowledge, drafts grounded responses, applies deterministic risk policy, routes uncertain/sensitive recommendations to authorized reviewers, publishes through a satisfied gate, and preserves auditable evidence. Classification, retrieval, generation, policy evaluation, approval and publication are distinct activities; separate records do not require separate screens. [Source: pp.7,11–12, §§2.1–2.2; `screen_functions:r1:c4:f1`, `screen_functions:r1:c11:f1`, `screen_functions:r1:c13:f4`]

The API scope includes enterprise document ingestion, permission-aware retrieval, grounded drafting, deterministic policy, human review, publication, audit and controlled operations. Physical automation, irreversible financial transactions, foundation-model fine-tuning, unrestricted browsing and agent cloud-administration permissions are **Out of scope**. Application-hosted GPU inference is excluded. Cross-region active/active mutation, OCR beyond English and customer-managed model weights are deferred. [Source: pp.7,9–10,19; `api:r1:c4:f1`, `api:r1:c7:f1`, `api:r1:c8:f5`, `api:r1:c25:f2`]

**Publication is distinct from approval.** Required evidence and satisfied versioned deterministic policy are prerequisites; unapproved high-risk runs cannot publish. Approval binds exactly reviewed content. Final-response pointer and satisfied gate commit atomically; replay cannot publish another artifact under old approval. Recompute authorization at publication after intervening tenant/document permission changes; reject stale evidence even after successful search/review. Publication invoker, endpoint/button, exact status mapping and recovery are open. [Source: pp.7,11–12,45–46,59; `screen_functions:r1:c4:f3`, `screen_functions:r1:c11:f2`, `screen_functions:r1:c13:f4`, `screen_functions:r1:c74:f1`, `screen_functions:r1:c76:f2`, `screen_functions:r1:c100:f2`]

Ranking is not authorization. Revoked source access must be effective **before next retrieval**, even while index cleanup is pending; source ACL changes invalidate affected cache before new results.
